Effets.eclairer: unmasks the wolf entering the house
Effets.annuler-vote: cancels a vote (the village votes again)
Effets.mordre: bites instead of killing: the victim joins the pack
Effets.epier: spies on the pack, at the risk of being caught
Effets.voir-actif: sees who went out at night

Victoires.execute: wins if executed by the village
Victoires.cible-executee: wins if the target is executed

Victoire.village: The village of Brumecombe wins: no wolf prowls the mist anymore.
Victoire.meute: The pack wins: Brumecombe falls asleep, never to wake.
Victoire.amoureux: The lovers {a} and {b} win, last survivors of the valley.

Table.PersonneEnVie: No one keeps vigil in Brumecombe anymore.
Table.AucunBatiment: No building drawn for this game.
Table.EliminerQuestion: Eliminate {nom}? Their lover, if any, will follow.
Table.ExecuterQuestion: The village chose {noms}. Proceed with the execution?
Table.AubeCalme: Dawn rises: no one died tonight.
Table.VoteAnnule: This vote was cancelled or is being replayed: nobody is executed.
Table.SecretsPerdus: This browser does not hold the secrets of the current game (another GM or browser): tonight's choices, bounties and vials are lost.
Table.Conteuse: For two minutes, everyone talks only about {nom}, who cannot answer.
Table.RejouerQuestion: Start a new game with the same players and AI companions? A new setup is drawn and roles are dealt again in secret.
Table.RejouerEnCours: The current game is not over. Abandon it and start a new one, with the same players and AI companions?
Table.MiseEnSceneAide: Puts tokens and light back according to the phase (this is automatic; this button fixes a disturbed scene).

Choix.InviteMeute: The pack is hunting. Which house do you visit tonight?
Choix.InviteVote: Village vote: who should be executed?
Choix.InviteChapelle: Chapel vote: who sleeps in shelter tonight?

Vote.Question: Whom should the village condemn?
Vote.TempsEcoule: Too late: voting time is over.
Vote.QuestionChapelle: Who will sleep in the shelter of the Chapel next night?

Fiche.RoleCache: This villager's role is a secret.

Role.AideOrdre: Lower order = wakes earlier. The pack wakes together at 40; a pack role set to 40 acts with it, at any other order it wakes separately.

RoleParDefaut.Description: No power, save a voice at the council and a nose for the mist.

Nuit.Amour: An arrow of mist binds you to {nom}: if one dies, the other follows.
Nuit.ProtectionRefusee: You cannot protect {nom} two nights in a row.
Nuit.EspionRepere: {nom} was caught spying on the pack and becomes its victim.
Nuit.Epier: Hidden in the mist, you hear the pack choose its prey: {nom}.
Nuit.MorsureEvitee: The bite on {nom} was fended off.
Nuit.Mordu: A bite in the night: you secretly join the pack.
Nuit.MorsureMj: {nom} was bitten and joins the pack.
Nuit.Embrasement: The doused houses go up in flames: {noms}.
Nuit.EclairerOui: Your lantern caught a wolf at {nom}'s: {loups}.
Nuit.VoirCamp: The ashes speak: {nom} belongs to the « {camp} » side.
Nuit.Cloche: The bell has rung: today's vote is double.
Nuit.EpierRepere: Yellow eyes turn toward you in the mist. You have been seen.
Nuit.EpierRien: The pack prowls but agrees on no prey.
Nuit.MemeCamp: {a} and {b} are on the same side.
Nuit.PasMemeCamp: {a} and {b} are not on the same side.
Nuit.Prime: Your target: {nom}. Get the village to condemn them.
Nuit.SilenceRefuse: You cannot silence {nom} two nights in a row.
Nuit.FioleVideRemede: Your remedy vial is empty: nothing happens.
Nuit.FioleVidePoison: Your poison vial is empty: nothing happens.
Nuit.MeuteEmpechee: No wolf could go out tonight: the pack did not hunt.
Nuit.Empeche: Away from home tonight, you could do nothing.
Nuit.Surveille: The watchman kept an eye on you: you could not leave your house.
Nuit.MeuteBredouille: The pack found nobody at {nom}'s: they slept out of reach.
Nuit.PontBloque: The pack could not cross the Bridge to reach {nom}.
Nuit.SauveAsile: The pack could not enter the Chapel, where {nom} slept.
Nuit.SauveTaverne: The pack did not dare kill {nom} at the Tavern.
Nuit.SilenceBeni: {nom} has been blessed: your howl has no hold on them.
Nuit.MessagerVide: {nom} wrote nothing: your satchel stayed empty.
Nuit.MessageRecu: The Messenger hands you a note from {nom}: “{texte}”
Nuit.InviteMessager: The Messenger knocks at your door tonight: write a sentence for {nom}. He will hand it over at dawn, from you.

Messages.Silence: A shadow took your voice: you will not speak at the next debate.
Messages.Emporter: {nom} dies and may take someone into the grave: ask for their choice.

Journal.AubeCalme: Dawn of round {tour}: no one died.
Journal.VoteNul: The vote is closed: no one is chosen.
Journal.VoteChapelle: The village chooses who will sleep in the Chapel.

RevelerALaMort.Aide: A dead villager's role is shown to everyone.

MortsVoientTout.Aide: A dead player sees everyone's role on the game table (and no longer votes).

DureeVote.Aide: Timer shown on the game table; 0 = no timer.

ChanceEpier.Aide: Probability (0 to 1) that a role spying on the pack is caught and becomes its victim.

AnnoncesEnChat.Aide: Deaths and victory are also announced in the chat.

CanalDesMorts.Aide: The dead may talk among themselves: their messages become whispers to the dead and the GM only. Otherwise, they can only whisper to the GM.

SalonsAutomatiques.Aide: With Foundry built-in voice (A/V): at night only the wolves talk to each other; the dead speak only to the dead; a silenced player stays quiet during the debate and the vote. Each browser mutes what it must not hear, and its own microphone when it must stay quiet. The GM always hears everything. Unchecked: everyone talks to everyone.

PlateauInteractif.Aide: Night choices, votes and day powers are made by clicking tokens, from the banner. Unchecked: the choice and vote windows open as before.

Erreurs.PasMJ: Only the active GM can run the game (lakour-loups).
Erreurs.PasDeJoueurs: No player to deal roles to.
Erreurs.SansRole: Both villagers must have a role.
Erreurs.PasDeVillageois: You do not play any villager.
Erreurs.PasDeMJ: No GM is connected: the power cannot be applied.
Erreurs.RolesInconnus: Unknown roles, or missing from the content: {roles}.
Erreurs.PersonneAReveiller: No one to wake for "{role}" tonight.

Carnet.Nouveau: A secret message awaits you in your notebook.
Carnet.Aide: What the narrator tells you, and you alone. Never copy it to the common channel.

Jour.Verrou: {qui} forges a lock for {nom}'s house: next night, the first wolf attack against it will fail.
Jour.Meule: {qui} asks the millstone: {n} wolf(s) still live in Brumecombe.
Jour.Garde: {qui} keeps an eye on {nom}: next night, {nom} cannot target any house but their own.
Jour.Benediction: {qui} blesses {nom}: nobody can silence them any more, and they speak first at the next debate.
Jour.TracesOui: {qui} followed {nom}'s tracks: {nom} left their house last night.
Jour.TracesNon: {qui} followed {nom}'s tracks: {nom} did not leave their house last night.
Jour.Gite: {qui} offers lodging to {nom}: next night, {nom} sleeps at the Tavern and their house stays empty.
Jour.Voix: {qui} gives {nom} their voice back: they may speak at the debate again.
Jour.Ruban: {qui} ties a ribbon around {nom}'s wrist: if they lead a vote, they get one more minute to defend themselves.
Jour.RubanDefense: {nom} wears the Weaver's ribbon: one more minute to defend themselves, the vote stays open.
Jour.Traversee: {qui} ferries {nom} across the river: next night, nobody can visit them, and they cannot act.
Jour.CrocsOui: {qui} examines {nom}'s body: it bears fang marks.
Jour.CrocsNon: {qui} examines {nom}'s body: it bears no fang marks.
Jour.Appel: {qui} calls the roll: everyone speaks {duree} seconds, in this order: {noms}.
Jour.Annule: {qui}, Justice of the Peace, cancels the vote: nobody is executed, and the village votes again at once, without a new debate.
Jour.Conteuse: A story runs through the gathering: for two minutes, the village talks only about {nom}, who cannot answer.
Jour.Taverne: {qui} will sleep at the Tavern next night.
Jour.Lame: {qui} takes a blade from the Forge.
Jour.Cachette: {qui} will hide in the Barn next night.
Jour.DernierMot: From the bottom of the Well, the voice of {qui}: “{texte}”
Jour.Asile: The village shelters {nom} in the Chapel: the pack cannot attack them next night.
Jour.IndiceRien: the mist covered everything: nobody knows anything about the night.
Jour.IndiceVisites0: no house was visited last night.
Jour.IndiceVisites1: a single house was visited last night.
Jour.IndiceSorties0: nobody left their bed last night.
Jour.IndiceSorties1: a single person left their bed last night.
Jour.IndiceSorties: {n} villagers left their beds last night.
Jour.IndicePair: the wolf who entered the victim's house sleeps in an even-numbered house.
Jour.IndiceImpair: the wolf who entered the victim's house sleeps in an odd-numbered house.
Jour.IndiceMemeRive: the wolf who entered the victim's house sleeps on the same bank.
Jour.IndiceAutreRive: the wolf who entered the victim's house crossed the Bridge to find them.
Jour.IndiceVoisins: two neighbouring houses were visited last night.
Jour.MoulinPrive: The Mill's stone whispers that {n} wolf(s) remain alive.
Jour.MoulinPublic: The Mill's sails have counted: {n} wolf(s) still live in Brumecombe.
Jour.Lavoir: At the wash-house, they say that {indice}
Jour.Cimetiere: The graves speak: {nom} belonged to the {camp} side.
Jour.InviteTexte: Your last word, ten words at most: the narrator will read it to the village.

Refus.inconnu: This day power does not exist.
Refus.absent: You do not have this power.
Refus.batiment: This building is not in play.
Refus.phase: This is not the time to use this power.
Refus.mort: The dead have no day power.
Refus.vivant: Only the dead can speak to the Well.
Refus.usage: This power has already been used.
Refus.nuit: Wait for the morning after a night.
Refus.vote: There is no vote to cancel: only right after the count, before the execution.
Refus.recent: The Well only listens to those who just died.
Refus.texte: A last word of {mots} words at most, and not empty.

Plateau.ChoisisSurLaCarte: Your turn: choose on the map (click a glowing token), then "Confirm" in the banner.

Bandeau.NouvellePartie: New game! Open "My role" to discover yours.
Bandeau.Vote: Vote: click the token of the one you accuse
Bandeau.VoteChapelle: Chapel: click the token of the one who will sleep in safety

Salon.taniere: 🐺 Den: you speak to the wolves
Salon.Aide: Voice room: what Foundry built-in voice lets you say and hear right now.

Bandeau.MonRoleAide: Your secret notebook: your role card and what you learn at night (only you can see it).

Attente.nuit: Night falls on Brumecombe: everyone stays home.
Attente.jour: The village debates on the square.

Parole.Mort: You are dead: the living no longer hear you. You may whisper to the narrator.
Parole.Silence: You are silenced: you cannot speak during today's debate and vote (whispering to the narrator is still allowed).
Parole.CanalDesMorts: You are dead: your messages now reach only the other dead and the narrator.

NouvellePartie.Annonce: New game! The roles of the {n} villagers are dealt in secret.

Detail.juge: The Justice of the Peace ({nom}) may still cancel this vote.
Detail.emporter: {nom} chooses whom to take along (or no one).
Detail.sansSecrets: This browser does not hold the night's secrets.

Preparation.IAAbsente: Enable the AI GM module to add AI players.
Preparation.IAIndisponible: AI players require the AI GM module.
Preparation.Trop: More roles than seats: remove some.
